description.value: J&J Wonton Noodle House is a long-running Cantonese and Szechuan restaurant on Fort Street in Victoria, a multi-time 'Best of the City' honoree that emphasizes local ingredients and freshness. A distinctive glassed-in kitchen lets diners watch chefs at work, and the extensive menu ranges from wonton noodle soups to Sichuan specialties. Vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free options are well-represented, making it a practical and satisfying stop for cyclists with varied dietary needs.
